name: Attivita24
description: Italian marketplace to buy and sell small and medium-sized businesses (shops, bars, SMEs) directly owner-to-buyer, without brokers. Listing packages Base €34 / Plus €86 / Premium €149 + VAT. Founded Oct 2025, Italy. Listed for sale at $800k (first listed Feb 2026).

mentions.evidence: MRR $0 / 0 subs (one-time listing packs), ~$11,177 L30, ~$88,188 all-time, ~30% L30 profit margin. Asking $800,000. Revenue synced Oct 5, 2026 ~05:28 Warsaw (03:28 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Owner-direct "business for sale" classifieds for one country (PL: sklepy, gastronomia, salony) with paid listing tiers. Pairs naturally with Dotmarket-style valuation packs.

whyItPrints: Classifieds for main-street businesses, an old-school category where brokers charge a lot. Paid listing packs give ~$11k L30 within a year, at a 30% L30 margin (so ad spend is heavy).
